summary: Forest Service tower on Apple Orchard Mountain, Bedford County; a lookout was on duty in 1933, and the tower was moved to Purgatory Mountain in 1957-1958.

facts.status_note: Moved to Purgatory Mountain in 1957-1958; an FAA radar now stands nearby on the summit.

access.note: Wikipedia says the summit is open

events.note: Lookout William Dawson, in an August 1933 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts
Moved to Purgatory Mountain, Botetourt County; the register dates the move 1957-1958

corrections.why: The register says the tower was relocated to Purgatory Mountain in 1957-1958, so the record's 'gone' hides that the tower was moved. Whether any part still stands at Purgatory is not confirmed by the sources read.

notes_for_editor: The move to Purgatory Mountain rests on the register sentence alone. The Purgatory Mountain register page is not in the cache (a guessed URL returned 404) and was not read, so the story reports only the Association's 'Tower Gone' entry for Purgatory. Whether any part of the frame stands there is unverified. A WebSearch snippet from willhiteweb.com gave 1955-1958 and a 60-foot tower with a 14 by 14 foot cab for the move; the page was not read, so it is not used. Access is inferred from Wikipedia's 'The summit is open' and should be confirmed with the Jefferson or George Washington National Forest. The record's 'gone' status is proposed as 'moved' in corrections for human review.
